storyCards.headline: Crimson And Clover: The Breakthrough Moment
storyCards.fact:
Joan Jett's "Crimson And Clover" reached #7 on the Billboard Hot 100. "Crimson and Clover" is a 1968 song by American rock band Tommy James and the Shondells.

Written by the duo of Tommy James and drummer Peter Lucia Jr., it was intended as a change in direction of the group's sound and composition.

"Crimson and Clover" was released in late 1968 as a rough mix after a radio station leaked it.

The song peaked at #7 on the Billboard Hot 100 and spent 15 weeks on the chart.

Chart story — peaked at #7 on the Hot 100.
